facts.text: I used a 20% off coupon on a purchase of $50 or more at Target last week.
I saved around $12 using the 20% off coupon on household essentials at Target.
I am using a few different apps and websites to find deals.
I want to set up a spreadsheet to track my coupons and discounts.
I want to create separate sheets for different types of coupons, including groceries, retail, and dining.
I want to add a column to track the date I received a coupon or discount.
I want to create a master sheet that lists all my coupons and discounts.
I want to add a Source Date column to help refine my coupon hunting strategy.
I want to use filters and conditional formatting on the master sheet.
I want to set up filters to sort and narrow down my coupon list by category, expiration date, or source.
I want to use conditional formatting to highlight upcoming expiration dates or high-value discounts.
I want to create a separate sheet to track my savings over time.
I want a table with columns for the date, coupon/discount, savings amount, and total savings.
I want to create a dashboard or summary sheet with charts or graphs to visualize savings over time.
I want the dashboard to include metrics like total savings, average savings per month, and percentage of purchases made with coupons.
I use cashback apps like Ibotta and Fetch Rewards to earn money back on my grocery purchases.

keyphrases: separate sheets for groceries retail dining

events.text: Used a 20% off coupon on a $50+ purchase at Target and saved around $12 on household essentials
